subject: design/e2e-verification-skills-v2
statement: The e2e authoring line stays **three separate skills** — `/e2e-design`, `/e2e-review`, `/e2e-plan` — each its own command and a single invocation, reusing existing machinery under the hood. Amendment 002 changes what each does, not how many there are:
